name: The Kiln-Warden
lore: The Tolling Order sent a bearer down the Kilnway the winter after the Ash Winter, with a bell and an order: nothing warm comes up. The bell has cracked in the heat and rings flat now, and the bearer's straps have burned through and been replaced with chain he found in the tube, but the order has not changed and neither has he. The ash-wights follow the warmth to him and he rings them down, and when he has rung them down he rings the tube for anything else that might be coming.

phases.name: nothing warm comes up
phases.say: The bell splits along its crack and he swings the halves on their chains. The lava under the floor answers the note.

name: Captain Hobb Wendle
lore: Hobb Wendle carted for the Guild until the Guild's tolls took his cart. He took the tolls back, a cart at a time, and then a road at a time, and when the Wardens left Scathe he took the fort, because a man who takes tolls should have a toll-house. He keeps honest books. Every tithe is written down, and so is every carter who would not pay it, and what happened to them.

phases.name: the tithe has gone up
phases.say: He throws the ledger at the forge and calls for the lads. The ones who are still standing come.
